title: Channel open before authentication does not end the connection
quote: If the server receives such a message before authentication, it MUST disconnect, preferably with a SSH_MSG_DISCONNECT.
rationale: After the initial KEX (with or without an accepted ssh-userauth SERVICE_REQUEST) and before authentication, CH_OPEN is answered without CLOSED/NO_CONN/DISCONNECT (v1 D2: OpenSSH answers UNIMPLEMENTED). Close detected only in a later step also matches; check the next output when replaying. Written by proto-sm stream A (v2) from v1 class D2 (report.md); vocabulary: teammate mapper (UNIMPLEMENTED, SERVICE_ACCEPT, CLOSED/NO_CONN, UA_PW_OK). An accepting word is a behaviour witness, not necessarily a bug.
